title: Discover Gibbston, New Zealand | Queenstown Official Website
facts: Gibbston is a nearby wine-growing area with wineries, food and cycling opportunities.
The Gibbston River Trail begins at Kawarau Bridge, and guided tours and shuttle options serve the area.
The official guide identifies Pinot Noir, wineries and cellar doors in Gibbston, within Central Otago wine country.
The historic Kawarau Suspension Bridge is a local landmark and start of the Gibbston River Trail.
